answer: Copper-seal pulse bond stops bulk fakes: each identity stakes 70 credits, files one copper seal. Each epoch brings a pulse; each signs one report before the dune shifts. Auditors replay the dune ledger: two reports, one key, one epoch is equivocation; the bond burns. K-th 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes spend 3,032,000, stake 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented copper seal fails: its owner's key shows on a second pulse. Honest identities pay 35 once.
